name: std/time

readme: Measures elapsed time using a monotonic nanosecond clock.

files.content:
-- Measures elapsed time using a monotonic nanosecond clock.
public use "time" function current() of type fallible unsigned 64.
public use "time" function sleep(duration of type unsigned 64) of type fallible nothing.
public function measure(task of type function taking () giving nothing) of type fallible unsigned 64 {
  constant first is try current().
  task().
  give (try current()) subtract first.
}
